title: Red Teaming Fundamentals
summary: Explore objective-driven simulations, rules of engagement, and detection collaboration.

lessons.title: Rules of engagement and deconfliction
lessons.summary: Keep simulations bounded, authorized, and measurable.
lessons.content: Agree on written authorization, scope, dates, prohibited actions, emergency contacts, data handling, and stop conditions. Coordinate deconfliction without undermining the agreed learning objectives.

quiz.question: What should happen before a red-team engagement?
options: Run reconnaissance first and ask later
Agree written authorization, scope, and stop conditions
quiz.explanation: Written scope and stop conditions establish safe, authorized boundaries.

lessons.title: Purple teaming and detection telemetry feedback
lessons.summary: Translating adversarial tactics into high-fidelity detection rules.
lessons.content: A successful red team exercise does not end with access; it culminates in a purple team review where defenders (Blue) verify whether telemetry and alerts fired at each phase of the MITRE ATT&CK chain.

quiz.question: What is the core objective of a Purple Team collaboration?
options: To prove the Red team is superior to the Blue team
To iteratively improve detection engineering and validate logging telemetry
To eliminate the need for firewalls
quiz.explanation: Purple teaming pairs offensive emulation directly with defensive validation to strengthen detection engineering.
